merge the data
```{r}
samples_full <- mget(c(
  "rif1_494", "rif2_501", "con1_499", "con2_504",
  paste0("GSE250130_con", 1:12),
  paste0("GSE250130_rif", 1:10),
  paste0("GSE183837_con", 1:3),
  paste0("GSE183837_rif", 1:6)
))

combined <- merge(
  x            = samples_full[[1]],
  y            = samples_full[-1],
  add.cell.ids = sapply(samples_full, function(x) unique(x$id)),
  merge.data   = FALSE
)

#saveRDS(combined, file = "<original_archive>/scRNA_doublets_REMOVED/scRNA_combined_july14.rds")

```

STEP 2: FILTER CELLS
Read in combined Seurat object
```{r}
combined<-readRDS("<original_archive>/scRNA_doublets_REMOVED/scRNA_combined_july14.rds")
combined$orig.ident <- combined$id

```

filter cells 
```{r, fig.width=20, fig.height=20}
combined[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(combined, pattern = "^MT-")
combined <- subset(combined, subset = percent.mt < 10)

VlnPlot(combined, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), group.by = "orig.ident", ncol = 3)

```

subsetting data with conservative thresholds (remove dead cells, doublets, etc)
```{r, fig.width=20, fig.height=10}
combined <- subset(
  combined,
  subset = nFeature_RNA > 300 &
           nFeature_RNA < 8000 &
           percent.mt < 20
)
VlnPlot(combined, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), group.by = "orig.ident", ncol = 3)

```

STEP 3: QC
```{r}
combined<- NormalizeData(combined)
combined <- FindVariableFeatures(combined)
combined <- ScaleData(combined, vars.to.regress = c("nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"))
combined <- RunPCA(combined)

#save
#saveRDS(combined, file = "<original_archive>/scRNA_combined_preharmony_july7.rds")
```

```{r}
ElbowPlot(combined)
```

UMAP
```{r}
combined<-RunUMAP(combined, dims = 1:20)
#saveRDS(combined_final, file = "<original_archive>/scRNAcombined_june17.rds")
```

Visualize
```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=10}
sample_plot<-DimPlot(combined, reduction='umap', group.by='sample')
study_plot<-DimPlot(combined, reduction='umap', group.by='study')
id_plot<-DimPlot(combined, reduction = 'umap', group.by = 'id')

sample_plot
study_plot
id_plot
```

STEP 4: RUN HARMONY FOR BATCH CORRECTION
```{r}
combined <- RunHarmony(
  object = combined,
  group.by.vars = c("study", "id")
)
```

Run Umap on batch corrected data
```{r}
combined <- RunUMAP(combined, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:20)
combined <- FindNeighbors(combined, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:20)
combined <- FindClusters(combined, resolution = 0.8)
```

Visualize harmony clusters ***group the clusters into tighter clusters 
```{r}
DimPlot(combined, group.by = "seurat_clusters", label = TRUE, reduction = "umap")
```
Cluster labeled plot
```{r, fig.height=8, fig.width=12}
combined@meta.data$supercluster <- case_when(
  combined@meta.data$seurat_clusters %in% c(2, 3, 4, 12, 19, 28, 9, 23, 22, 8, 15, 24, 29, 31) ~ "Group_1_2",
  combined@meta.data$seurat_clusters %in% c(1, 10, 11, 13, 14, 27, 20)                         ~ "Group_3",
  combined@meta.data$seurat_clusters %in% c(0, 5, 6, 7, 26, 17, 25)                            ~ "Group_4",
  TRUE                                                                                        ~ "Other"
)
table(combined@meta.data$supercluster)

combined@meta.data$supercluster <- recode(combined@meta.data$supercluster,
  "Group_1_2" = "Immune and Vascular Cells",
  "Group_3"   = "Epithelial Cells",
  "Group_4"   = "Fibroblast Cells"
)


p <- DimPlot(
  combined,
  reduction = "umap",
  group.by = "supercluster",
  label = TRUE,
  label.size = 3,
  repel = TRUE
) +
  ggtitle("UMAP with Cell Labelled Clusters") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

#ggsave("UMAP_superclusters.png", p, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)

```

```{r, fig.width=14, fig.height=10}
ggsave("UMAP_sample.png", p, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```

```{r, fig.height=15, fig.width=15}
  reduction = "umap",
```

STEP 5: AGGREGATION
aggregation
```{r}
pseudobulk_counts <- AggregateExpression(
  combined,
  group.by = "id",      
  assays = "RNA",
  slot = "counts",       #raw counts
  return.seurat = FALSE
)$RNA

#saveRDS(pseudobulk_counts, file = "pseudobulk_matrix_july14.rds")

```
make into matrix
```{r}
pseudo_dense <- as.matrix(pseudobulk_counts)

```

dataframe
```{r}
pseudo_df <- as.data.frame(pseudo_dense)
pseudo_df <- tibble::rownames_to_column(pseudo_df, var = "GeneSymbol")
write.csv(pseudo_df, file = "pseudobulk_counts_july15.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```

2D PCA
```{r}
# Convert to dense matrix and transpose
pseudo_t <- t(as.matrix(pseudobulk_counts))
log_t <- log1p(pseudo_t)

# Create condition labels from sample names
condition <- ifelse(grepl("con", rownames(log_t), ignore.case = TRUE), "Control", "RIF")

# Run PCA
pca <- prcomp(log_t, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

# Plot with consistent coloring
plot(pca$x[,1:2],
     col = ifelse(condition == "Control", "skyblue", "salmon"),
     pch = 19,
     xlab = paste0("PC1 (", round(summary(pca)$importance[2,1]*100, 1), "%)"),
     ylab = paste0("PC2 (", round(summary(pca)$importance[2,2]*100, 1), "%)"),
     main = "Pseudobulk PCA by Condition")
legend("topright", legend = c("Control", "RIF"), col = c("skyblue", "salmon"), pch = 19)

```
3D PCA
```{r}
library(plotly)
library(htmlwidgets)

# Create a data frame for plotting
pca_df <- as.data.frame(pca$x[, 1:3])
pca_df$condition <- condition

# Generate the interactive 3D PCA plot
#pca_3d_plot <- 
  plot_ly(
  data = pca_df,
  x = ~PC1,
  y = ~PC2,
  z = ~PC3,
  color = ~condition,
  colors = c("skyblue", "salmon"),
  type = "scatter3d",
  mode = "markers"
) %>%
  layout(title = "3D PCA of Pseudobulk Samples",
         scene = list(
           xaxis = list(title = "PC1"),
           yaxis = list(title = "PC2"),
           zaxis = list(title = "PC3")
         ))

# Save the plot as an interactive HTML file
```
